name: Dymo Label
description: Print asset and parts labels on a Dymo LabelWriter 550 via SSH over Tailscale.

tailscaleHost.description: Tailscale hostname or IP of the Mac with the Dymo printer attached.

sshUser.description: SSH user on the remote host. Defaults to the current local user.

printerName.description: CUPS printer name on the remote host. Auto-discovered if omitted.

defaultBinLocation.description: Default bin/shelf location when not provided by the agent.
